summary: Fixes profile-picture upload for users with no picture; removeUserOldImageFromCDN now takes the image URL from the client; renames Prisma client db->prisma everywhere; moves getUserSubscriptionPlan into a 'use server' file (making it publicly callable).

statements.text: Anyone can use the "get user subscription plan" action on your server without logging in.
statements.why: 'use server' in src/actions/subscription.ts exposes getUserSubscriptionPlan(userId) with no session check; returns Stripe ids/period for any userId.

statements.text: The dashboard billing page changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /[locale]/dashboard/billing
statements.why: Only an import path changed; true but uninformative.

statements.text: getUserSubscriptionPlan() was a helper in src/lib/subscription.ts. It moved into a "use server" file, so the browser can now call it directly. It looks up users.
statements.why: Accurate: moved and gained 'use server'; it looks up a user's subscription details.

statements.text: The stripe part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet ... Make a test payment before you ship. /api/stripe
statements.why: Only an import path changed; test payment advice is harmless.

statements.text: The agent changed the auth login github callback, ... update user and remove user old image from cdn parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Lumps a pure db->prisma rename with the two real behaviour changes (remove-old-image takes URL from browser; no-picture skip) without describing either.

statements.text: The agent also changed settings-form.tsx, uploadthing/core.ts and pricing.tsx, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: settings-form and uploadthing core have real changes; pricing is an import path only.

misses.what: removeUserOldImageFromCDN is a server action with no login or ownership check and now deletes whatever UploadThing URL the caller passes, so anyone can delete arbitrary files from the app's storage.
The actual fix: users without a profile picture can now upload an avatar and save settings; before, saving failed.
updateUser(id, payload) in the settings actions is still an unauthenticated server action that updates any user's name/email/picture (pre-existing).
